name: word-count
description: Counts words, sentences, and characters in a text string. Returns wordCount, sentenceCount, charCount, and charCountNoSpaces.

name: json-validate
description: Validates whether a string is valid JSON. Returns valid (boolean), error message if invalid, and the parsed object if valid.

text.description: The string to validate as JSON

valid.description: Whether the string is valid JSON

error.description: Parse error message (only present when valid is false)

parsed.description: The parsed JSON value (only present when valid is true)

name: list-recent
description: Lists files in a directory modified within the last N days. Returns an array of objects with path, modified (ISO timestamp), and size (bytes).

directory.description: Absolute or relative directory path to scan

days.description: How many days back to look (default: 7)

files.description: Array of { path, modified, size } for matching files
